searchBreadth: Seven opportunities discovered across experimental sound, ecology, coordination history, planetary definitions, archives/imaging, monetary institutions and everyday mechanisms; discover first and classify afterward. Failed acquisition and initial leads remain explicit.

candidates.subject: Sand reveals where a vibrating plate stays still
candidates.novelty: Fresh audible-to-visible mechanism, no prior plate/nodes story.
candidates.evidenceFeasibility: Three inspected institutional bodies including an experimental acoustics lab.
candidates.explanatoryPayoff: Reverse the intuitive idea that the grains mark the strongest motion.
candidates.visualPotential: Visible grain redistribution plus slowed side view; visually explanatory at every beat.
candidates.audienceCuriosity: A beautiful pattern demands a cause; the cause reverses intuition.
candidates.productionFeasibility: Requires a new deterministic grain/plate adapter; exact trajectories remain disclosed illustration.
candidates.portfolioDiversity: Adds experimental sound and material motion without selecting by category.
candidates.comparison: Selected for immediate visual curiosity and a compact, evidence-supported causal reversal.
limitations: No model proposal or search excerpt is claim verification; no invented performance evidence.
